title: Call recaps
description: After a client call, turn the owner's notes from the call into a short recap email for the client and a list of action items

settings.TONE: how the recap should sound, in a few words
settings.SIGN_OFF: how the owner signs off an email
settings.SEND: send the recap to the client (true) or keep it as a draft for the owner (false)
settings.MAX_PER_RUN: how many calls it recaps at most in one run
